card.name: The word see in label cross-references
card.fires_on: The word "see" inside a square bracket that points to another label section, such as [see Dosage and Administration (2.3)]. Weaker cases are a space before a number of weeks or the start of a brand name.

modes.label: Bracketed see
modes.description: The word see opening a cross-reference to Dosage and Administration or Warnings and Precautions.

modes.label: Space before duration
modes.description: A blank space just before a number of weeks in a dosing schedule.

modes.label: Brand name start
modes.description: The first letter of a brand name in a restart or discontinue instruction.
